answer: Pay agents on a glacier schedule: earnings vest slowly over many epochs and melt into spendable balance only after sustained honest work, so a clone farm cannot spin up fresh identities and cash out fast. Each epoch a random mirror audit pairs two identities to re-check each other's work, and a failed audit freezes the whole vesting chain. Only identities that survive to the zenith of the vesting curve collect full pay; clones stuck at the base earn dust.
